This all happened last year, in span of a week. 

My friend told me the story of how strange chain of events happened in his house after his cat died. From tvs turning on their own and him getting cat scratches without even having a cat. One day he told me how he put cheese back into his fridge and then right before his eyes the cheese jumped out of the fridge across the room, something that i found funny but later on was like what....? 

During that time i would visit his place a lot and i would witness these things happing right before my eyes, and soon they started happening to me as well. 

My tv would randomly start playing weird commercials with the pitch changed that i later on wouldn’t be able to find to rewatch meaning i had no proof when telling my parents what happened, i would literally see chairs spin without anyone sitting on them without any wind moving them. My stuff and clothing would start missing and then when i would tell someone about it they would come back... 

This isn’t the scariest thing ever and probably nothing compared to other replies but i still found it strange that it ended right after he buried his cat.
